tasks.title: Peer Learning Project
tasks.instruction: Write an email to your English teacher.

promptBlocks.text: Your teacher has asked you to choose a topic for a peer learning project. Read the notes below and write an email to your teacher.

promptBlocks.subject: Peer learning project
paragraphs: Please choose a topic for our peer learning project and tell me why you think it's a good choice. Also, let me know if you prefer to work in a pair or a group.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: Reason: makes studying fun and effective
Ask teacher for advice on how to start

tasks.title: Peer Learning Project Participation
tasks.instruction: Write an article for your college magazine.

promptBlocks.text: Your college magazine is running a series on student activities. The editor has asked you to write an article about the peer learning project. Do you think it's a good idea for students to take part? What are the benefits? What challenges might there be?

tasks.title: Long-Term Value of Peer Learning
tasks.instruction: Write a story for an English-speaking friend.

promptBlocks.text: Your English-speaking friend wants to hear a story about something you learned from a classmate. Write a story that begins with the following sentence:
"I never thought I would learn so much from a simple conversation with my classmate."
